# Sharing Requirements Checklist: Reliable Session Sharing, and Sharing from the Wrist

**Purpose**: Test whether the requirements for staying on a shared match and for the watch
experience are complete, clear, consistent and measurable, before `/speckit-tasks`
**Created**: 2026-10-27
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md) · design: [data-model.md](../data-model.md),
[contracts/](../contracts/), [research.md](../research.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `/speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Does the spec say what may bring an ended host's app back to running (the user, its watch, the radio), so that SC-010's 30 seconds start from something observable? [Gap, Measurability, Spec §FR-025, §SC-010]
- [x] CHK002 Is the time after which guests are told the host is out of reach stated in FR-026, as the host's view of its guests is in FR-010? [Completeness, Spec §FR-026, §FR-010]
- [x] CHK003 Does FR-005 cover one guest *slowing* the others past FR-002's times, as well as taking them off the match? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, Research RC-3, RC-4]
- [x] CHK004 Is what happens to a guest's copy of the match when the host stops sharing specified in the spec, or only in the design? [Gap, Spec §US4 scenario 6, Research D-9]
- [x] CHK005 Is it specified whether a guest keeps the code after the host stops sharing, given that FR-025 only names "joins another match" as the end of a guest's copy? [Gap, Spec §FR-025, §FR-024]
- [x] CHK006 Are requirements defined for finishing or settling the match on a guest while the host is out of reach, beyond FR-026's "keep scoring"? [Gap, Spec §FR-026]
- [x] CHK007 Is it complete who counts towards FR-001's seven guests: a guest's phone and watch once, a watch that joined without its phone, an older build? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001, Data model §Participant]
- [x] CHK008 Are requirements stated for a guest on their watch alone (phone left at home) staying on the match, given a watch keeps a link only while a workout runs or Rekkert is on screen? [Gap, Spec §FR-021, §FR-009]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is "in range" in FR-002 and SC-002 defined, or explicitly tied to the 30-metre assumption? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, §Assumptions]
- [x] CHK010 Are the start and end of FR-002's timing defined (from the tap on the scoring device to the point showing on another), so the simulated and field tests measure the same thing? [Clarity, Spec §FR-002, Data model §LinkRecord]
- [x] CHK011 Are FR-003's "once it can" and FR-007's "not present its score as current" bounded by times in the requirements themselves, rather than only by SC-003 and SC-004? [Clarity, Spec §FR-003, §FR-007, §SC-003, §SC-004]
- [x] CHK012 Are "in step", "catching up" and "out of reach" defined in the spec, or only by the data model's 15-second thresholds? [Clarity, Spec §FR-010, Data model §ParticipantState]
- [x] CHK013 Is "showing Rekkert" in FR-014 and FR-027 defined for the watch's in-between states: wrist down with Rekkert still in front, Always On dimmed, another app in front? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-014, §FR-027]
- [x] CHK014 Are "large enough to read out" (FR-017) and "a form a phone camera can scan" (FR-018) quantified, with a size, a scanning distance and the smallest watch they must work on? [Measurability, Spec §FR-017, §FR-018, Contract watch-ui]
- [x] CHK015 Is what counts as a "tap", including reaching the watch's menu page, defined once and applied the same way in FR-017, FR-022, SC-007 and SC-008? [Clarity, Spec §FR-017, §FR-022, §SC-007, §SC-008, Contract watch-ui]
- [x] CHK016 Are the reasons a guest's watch must give in FR-016 ("say why") listed? [Clarity, Spec §FR-016, Contract watch-ui]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK017 Does FR-002 ("every other device in range") agree with FR-014, under which a guest's watch shows the match only while Rekkert is on screen or a workout runs? [Conflict, Spec §FR-002, §FR-014]
- [x] CHK018 Does the spec say that FR-001's "every device showing the same score" holds only while the host can be reached, as FR-026 implies? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-026]
- [x] CHK019 Do SC-005 ("the incident's failure", singular) and FR-006 ("each failure found") agree, now that research found several causes? [Consistency, Spec §SC-005, §FR-006, Research Part 1]
- [x] CHK020 Does each failure reason in FR-008 have a matching status text in the watch contract? "Host out of range" on a first join has none there. [Consistency, Spec §FR-008, Contract watch-ui]
- [x] CHK021 Are the guest-state names and thresholds the same on the host's phone, on the host's watch, and in the data model? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, §FR-020, Data model §ParticipantState]
- [x] CHK022 Do FR-022 (two taps plus a confirmation), SC-008 (three taps) and the contract's Leave path agree? [Consistency, Spec §FR-022, §SC-008, Contract watch-ui]
- [x] CHK023 Is FR-001's "MAY be turned away" past seven consistent with the design's firm refusal and with FR-008's "no room"? [Consistency, Spec §FR-001, §FR-008, Research D-8]
- [x] CHK024 Does the data model's outbox rule (an out-of-reach participant stops holding events back after 60 seconds) state in writing how it keeps FR-004's "nothing lost", by catching up from the log rather than the outbox? [Consistency, Spec §FR-004, Data model §Delivery]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK025 Is the simulated radio required to be calibrated against the field test before SC-009 counts as met by simulation alone? [Assumption, Spec §SC-009, §SC-011, Quickstart §5]
- [x] CHK026 Can SC-006 ("the records alone are enough to tell") be judged objectively, for example by a named set of failure cases the records must tell apart? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]
- [x] CHK027 Is the way SC-012's battery comparison is taken (start charge, same match length, workout on or off) specified well enough that two runs are comparable? [Measurability, Spec §SC-012]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK028 Are recovery requirements stated for a guest's watch once its phone's app is opened again after being ended: does the watch hand back to the phone, and does anybody see that it did? [Coverage, Recovery, Spec §FR-009]
- [x] CHK029 Are alternate flows specified for the host's watch when there is no match on, or the host is between matches, and Share match is chosen? [Coverage, Alternate, Spec §FR-020, §US4 scenario 1]
- [x] CHK030 Are requirements defined for a watch joining another match while its own phone is hosting one, which would stop sharing for everyone on it? [Coverage, Exception, Gap, Spec §FR-021]
- [x] CHK031 Is the visibility of watch controls by role specified: host controls never on a guest's watch, Leave never on the host's? [Coverage, Spec §FR-020, §FR-022, Contract watch-ui]
- [x] CHK032 Is asking once before a guest's watch starts a match of its own (which takes its phone off the shared code) captured as a requirement, rather than only a design decision? [Traceability, Gap, Research D-12, RW-3]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK033 Is behaviour defined when a kept code reaches its 12-hour limit while the match is still being played and shared? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-025]
- [x] CHK034 Is behaviour defined for Join again on a kept code whose match is no longer being shared? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-024, Contract watch-ui]
- [x] CHK035 Is FR-027 specified for when notification permission has been refused, or when the phone is unlocked in someone's hand, so the notification shows there rather than on the watch? [Edge Case, Gap, Spec §FR-027]
- [x] CHK036 Is the precedence specified when several of the watch's status lines apply at once, for example the iPhone and the host both out of reach? [Edge Case, Spec §FR-011, Contract watch-ui]
- [x] CHK037 Is the two-courts edge case (every guest lands on the match whose code they typed) traced to a functional requirement or success criterion? [Traceability, Spec §Edge Cases]

## Non-Functional Requirements

- [x] CHK038 Are accessibility requirements stated for the new watch screens: VoiceOver reading the code digit by digit, larger text for status lines, and a text alternative to the QR image? [Gap, Spec §FR-017, §FR-018, §FR-011]
- [x] CHK039 Are non-visual cues (haptics) required when a guest's own state changes, such as host out of reach or back in step, given phones are in bags and the watch may be wrist-down? [Gap, Spec §FR-007, §FR-026]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK040 Is the assumption that an ended app "cannot be woken by the match" still correct, now that the design relies on the system relaunching it for Bluetooth, and does FR-009 state its dependence on a workout running on the guest's watch? [Assumption, Conflict, Spec §Assumptions, §FR-009, Research D-3]

## Notes

- Focus: staying on the match (FR-001..FR-009, FR-025, FR-026) and the watch experience
  (FR-014..FR-024, FR-027), across the spec, data model and contracts. Privacy of the
  kept code and record, and compatibility between builds, were left out by choice.
- Depth: standard. Audience: the author, before `/speckit-tasks`; fixes go back into
  `spec.md` (and the contracts where noted).
- Mark items `[x]` only after review confirms the requirement-quality criterion is satisfied
- Leave items unchecked when they still require clarification, correction, or reviewer evaluation
- `/speckit-implement` reads checklist checkbox state as a gate and must not modify markers
- `checklists/requirements.md` has a separate built-in lifecycle maintained by `/speckit-specify` and `/speckit-clarify`
- Add comments or findings inline
